utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, how many repairs are we actually covering, and who’s bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the final count yet, but folks said they’re prioritizing the porch steps and the fence first. Dan’s bringing a drill, and I think Rosa said she has the rest of the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, then when are they locking the list, and do we need to bring any extra lumber for the steps?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple sawhorses for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, that’d help a lot—thanks, Gus. I keep forgetting who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem—I’ll bring the drill and the sawhorses, and I can toss in my level too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Pia, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks keep asking what tools or parts they should bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but we should make a clear list first so we don’t end up with five hammers and no extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Exactly—I’ll tell people we need extension cords, power strips, screwdrivers, and spare parts first, then tools after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to pitch in, Opal—what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: First, let’s check the folding tables and tool bins by the community center lot, then I’ll note anything missing or broken.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll start with the folding tables and tool bins and call out anything that looks broken or missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m getting the word out fast—can you come by the repair drive and maybe bring anyone handy with tools?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit, but I’ll be keeping a low profile. I don’t have anyone else to bring, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That still helps a lot, Uli—thanks for coming by, even briefly. Just swing through when you can and we’ll keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m getting the repair drive organized, and I’d love to make sure we’ve got the right volunteers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Happy to help—what roles still need people, and what time are you expecting folks to show up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — we still need two fix-it table helpers and one person to manage check-in, and I’m asking volunteers to arrive by 9:30 so we can be ready by 10.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we set anything up, can you remind me which repairs are included in the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in a bit late—are we talking small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics, or was there a different list already?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That matches what I had in mind, but let’s confirm it before we announce anything—small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Faye — we can slot you into a midday shift between pickup and drop-off if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works well for me—if you tell me the exact window, I’ll plan around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard about the repair drive from Sam, so I might have this wrong, but are they still collecting supplies this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, that’s what I heard too—they’re still collecting supplies this weekend. If you want, I can check with Sam and make sure the timing hasn’t changed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—I’m just going off what Sam mentioned, and I don’t want to show up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive—just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what needs fixing first, and who’s actually bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t sorted the full list—just send me the basics, and I’ll bring my toolbox if we still need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a little about it, but not much yet—what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think we still need volunteers for bikes and small appliances, and maybe a table for tools if I’m remembering right.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could probably help with the small appliances table for a bit—do you know who’s organizing volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, Cleo—want me to tell folks you’re interested too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, tell them I’m in—I can also keep track of what tools and supplies people bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—I’ll let people know you’re in and that you can track the tools and supplies folks bring.
